TITLE:
Indoor Beer Hall Waitress Portrait

IDENTITY LOCK:
None.

Ultra-realistic photorealism.

Authentic skin texture.

Beautiful Japanese woman in her early 20s.
Long dark brown hair with soft see-through bangs.
Large dark brown eyes.
Natural makeup.
Healthy fair skin.

Pronounced feminine hourglass figure.
Natural feminine curves.
Realistic anatomy.

Elegant light-gray high-cut one-piece Thong swimsuit with a low open-back design, styled as a themed beer hall waitress outfit.

Lively indoor European-style beer hall.

A wooden serving counter with freshly prepared food and drinks.
Authentic restaurant atmosphere with warm and inviting lighting.

Standing beside a wooden serving counter in a natural three-quarter rear pose.
Her hips angled away from the camera, with her shoulders gently turned toward it.
Looking directly back over her shoulder, with her face clearly visible.
Gentle, welcoming smile as if greeting a customer.
Holding a black serving tray with food and beer mugs steadily in one hand at waist height.
Her arm relaxed and her posture natural.
Long hair flowing naturally down her back.

CAMERA:
Vertical 3:4 composition.
Eye-level perspective.
Three-quarter rear view.
Framed from head to upper thighs.
Natural handheld smartphone photography.

LIGHTING:
Warm indoor ambient lighting.
Soft golden highlights from pendant lights.
Realistic shadows and natural skin texture.

DETAILS:
Authentic beer hall waitress atmosphere.
Realistic serving tray, food and beer mugs.
Natural fabric texture.
Candid lifestyle photography.
Lively restaurant background with subtle depth of field.

NEGATIVE / CONSTRAINTS:
No CGI.
No illustration.
No anime.
No plastic skin.
No text or watermark.
No malformed anatomy or extra limbs.
No unnatural body twisting.
No floating objects.
No distorted hands or serving tray.
